tasks.label: Build Fantasy Library Package
tasks.command: cmake --build build --config Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '.\dist' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '.\dist' | Out-Null; Copy-Item '.\build\Release\FantasyLibrary.exe' '.\dist\'; Copy-Item '.\word_seeker_storybook_loop.ogg' '.\dist\'; Copy-Item '.\words.json' '.\dist\'; Copy-Item '.\bear_story.json' '.\dist\'; Copy-Item '.\assets' '.\dist\assets' -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item '.\Fantasy-Library-Test.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path '.\dist\*' -DestinationPath '.\Fantasy-Library-Test.zip'; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Fantasy Library test package created!' }
